E3: 25T12@200 U-BARS LEGS 1200 (U08) + 2T12 T&B EDGE BARS (U05)
E4: 25T12@200 U-BARS LEGS 1200 (U08) + 2T12 T&B EDGE BARS (U05)

T12@200 U-BARS AT SLAB EDGE + 2T12 T&B LONGITUDINAL
BURSTING / SPALLING STEEL AT PT ANCHORAGE ZONE, ALL FREE EDGES
U-BARS TOP & BOTTOM LEGS; RINGS LAPPED CLASS B
1. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE IN MILLIMETRES UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. DO NOT SCALE FROM THIS DRAWING.
2. CONCRETE f'c = 35 MPa (drawing). REINFORCEMENT: DEFORMED BARS fy = 420 MPa (drawing). CLEAR COVER 25 mm TOP AND
3. SLAB THICKNESS 250 mm. THIS SHEET IS TO BE READ WITH THE STRUCTURAL CONSULTANT'S DRAWINGS AND THE PT LAYOUT; ANY
DISCREPANCY TO BE REFERRED TO THE ENGINEER BEFORE FABRICATION.
4. BAR MARKS REFER TO THE SCHEDULE ON THIS SHEET. LENGTHS ARE CUTTING LENGTHS INCLUDING HOOKS. QUANTITIES ARE FOR THIS
5. TENSION LAPS ARE CLASS B (1.3 ld) PER SBC 304-18 §25.5.2; NOT MORE THAN 50 % OF BARS LAPPED AT ONE SECTION, LAPS
STAGGERED BY AT LEAST ONE LAP LENGTH.
6. BARS ENDING AT A FREE EDGE TERMINATE WITH A STANDARD 90° HOOK (12 Ø) UNLESS NOTED.
7. U-BARS T12@200 WITH 1200 mm LEGS TOP AND BOTTOM ALONG ALL PT ANCHORAGE EDGES (BURSTING / SPALLING STEEL), WITH 2T12
LONGITUDINAL BARS TOP AND BOTTOM INSIDE THE U-BARS. U-BAR DEPTH = SLAB THICKNESS - 2 x COVER = 200 mm.
8. AROUND CIRCULAR REGIONS: RADIAL U-BARS T12@150 (LEGS 1200) PLUS 2T12 RING BARS TOP AND BOTTOM, RINGS LAPPED CLASS B.
9. U-BARS ARE PLACED BEFORE THE ANCHORAGES ARE FIXED; DO NOT CUT U-BARS TO SUIT ANCHORAGE POCKETS - RELOCATE WITHIN THE
A1. Bottom mesh not specified: T12@200 both ways assumed as bonded reinforcement in PT zones.
A2. Edge U-bars not specified: T12@200 with 1200 mm legs assumed at PT anchorage edges.
A3. Opening trimmers not specified: 2T16 T&B each side + 2T12 diagonals at corners assumed.
A4. Void trimmers not specified: 2T12 T&B each side assumed.
A5. Stock bar length 12 m; laps staggered so that not more than 50 % of bars lap at one section.
A6. U-bar edge zones not marked on the drawing: U-bars applied along the entire slab perimeter (PT anchorage zones).
SBC 304-18 AS STATED ON THE STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS. DEVELOPMENT, ANCHORAGE AND LAP LENGTHS PER SBC 304-18 CHAPTER 25 (ACI
